value.name: Commuter rider
value.description: Commuters aged 20-60 riding the e-bike daily

value.name: Fleet operator
value.description: Operates shared/rental e-bike fleets; cares about uptime, visibility, security

value.text: I want to ride my daily commute there and back on assist without stopping to recharge, because a commute cut short by a flat battery makes me give up on e-bike commuting.

value.name: Assisted range
value.metric: Distance ridden at 25 km/h assist on one full charge

value.text: I want the bike to be quiet so riding feels natural, because motor whine feels cheap and annoys me and people around me.

value.name: Drive noise
value.metric: A-weighted sound pressure at 1 m during assisted riding

value.text: I want to ride in heavy rain and hose the bike down without it breaking, because I commute year-round in all weather.

value.name: Survival of powerful water jets
value.metric: Functional failures after IPX6 (IEC 60529) water-jet exposure

value.text: I want the drive to keep working for years without major repair, because it is the most expensive part of my bike.

value.name: Service life
value.metric: Years of commuter use before drive-unit end of life

value.text: I want the bike light enough to carry up stairs and onto trains and to handle like a normal bicycle, because the drive adds most of the extra weight.

value.name: Drive unit mass
value.metric: Mass of drive unit (motor + controller + battery interface)

value.text: I need depleted bikes back in service quickly without waiting for them to charge, because every hour a bike sits charging is lost rental revenue.

value.name: Energy restore time
value.metric: Time for a field crew to return a depleted bike to full available energy
value.source: PRD.md (swappable battery); numeric target PROVISIONAL - needs human confirmation

value.text: I need to know where every bike is and what state it is in without visiting it, because crews are dispatched from remote status and stale data wastes trips.

value.name: Status freshness
value.metric: Max age of location/state data per vehicle while in network coverage
value.source: PRD.md (telemetry); numeric target PROVISIONAL - needs human confirmation

value.text: I need to fix and improve bike software across the fleet without bringing bikes in, because a physical recall costs crew time and takes bikes off the street.

value.name: Fleet update reach
value.metric: Share of fleet on a released software version within 7 days, with zero depot visits
value.source: PRD.md (firmware OTA); numeric target PROVISIONAL - needs human confirmation

value.text: I need bikes to be useless to thieves and unauthorised riders, because a bike that still assists is worth stealing and theft is a major asset loss.

value.name: Unauthorised assist
value.metric: Assist events delivered while vehicle is locked

author: agent:needs
rationale: Rider and fleet-operator needs from PRD, in stakeholder language with causal driver ('because ...'). PRD solution terms (swappable battery, BLE/LTE, OTA, theft lock) kept out of need text and recorded only as MoE source. One numeric MoE per need. MOE-06/07/08 targets are PROVISIONAL — PRD gives no number. Supersedes probe patch 7cf2429546 (STK-RIDER only) — reject that one.
